expected: Revocation accepted by any reasonable means, including replies of stop, quit, end, revoke, opt out, cancel, unsubscribe, free-text revocations, voice, email or telling staff.
actual: Inbound handling matches only the exact single words stop, stopall, unsubscribe, cancel, end, quit after stripping non-letters (route.ts:23, 89). 'revoke' and 'opt out' (normalised to 'optout') are not recognised, and a sentence such as 'please stop texting me' is passed to the AI intake instead of opting out.
